source: Original project-authored SVG layers, rendered by Apple Icon Composer ictool. User-selected variant B with thicker connections.
role: Three mutually connected smooth gold stars on navy; the lower-right star is larger and farther right.
derivatives: The bundler uses sips and iconutil to produce a static ICNS. The editable .icon source is retained; dynamic system appearances are not integrated.
usage: Original project artwork selected by the user; no imported third-party artwork.

flat_variant.source: Project-authored flat SVG using the same star and connection geometry.
flat_variant.usage: Bundled local artwork; no network, font or third-party artwork dependency.

windows_variant.source: pttstella.png; resized using Pillow 12.3.0 ICO writer (LANCZOS)
windows_variant.usage: Same original project artwork; embedded in the Windows executable and used for the window/taskbar.
